items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1960-08-23
items.q: But I mean Manu Manella and Kato and all them kind of fellas. They played just that real stuff. Real straight stuff. Which Kato is this? What you call him? I don't know.

ctx.x: Well I didn't hear many variations there. He sounded like he was playing pretty much the melody.

Well yeah well I mean you if you're talking about get off or something like that. Maybe that what you mean. Yeah did Perez get off? Little not much. I wouldn't say a whole lot. See them fellas sometimes he didn't do like like Buddy Petit and Renny and then when we come up. See them fellas they play straight stuff. Mmhmm. And they started putting extra stuff in this stuff here. Later and Buddy and Renny and them time from what I can see. King Oliver and them kind of fellas. They started putting you know more to…
It was big and little Kato. Two piano players. Dad used to talk to us about that. What about Bonk? How did he play in the olden days? When you first heard?
